description: This Java source file defines the 'FeatureNotAccessibleException' class, a specific exception indicating that a requested feature is inaccessible due to non-existence or insufficient permissions within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing the exception from messages or JSON, and a builder class for creating instances with custom data.

classes.name: FeatureNotAccessibleException
classes.description: An immutable exception class indicating that a specific feature on a thing is not accessible, either because it does not exist or due to access restrictions. Contains static methods to create instances from messages or JSON and a nested builder class for customization.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance to construct a FeatureNotAccessibleException with specified ThingId and featureId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with the specified headers, preserving other exception information.
